ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed for those seeking to be general managers as well as Human Resource professionals. A systematic overview is provided for managing an organization?s human resources to support organizational goals. The curriculum includes key human resource functions (recruitment, training, performance management, compensation, etc), strategic alignment of HR functions, high performance work system, labor-management issues as well as international human resource management. This course uses a blended (hybrid) learning format, using online assignments to help you prepare for in-class group discussions and individual reflections. The class will meet once weekly for a 2-hour block to facilitate case discussions, applying skills and concepts learned to the workplace. Prerequisites will be enforced. This section will open to business minors on Monday, November 12, 2012, to all students in the College of Business on Monday, November 19, 2012, and to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 26, 2012 at approximately 9:00 a.m.
